"""Local probe: how a failed controlled-worker script request appears to the page, its
console and Chrome's network log, and what helpers.open_ready_page reports for it."""
import json, os, platform, sys, threading, time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from functools import partial
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
repo = Path(sys.argv[1]); out = Path(sys.argv[2])
sys.path[:0] = [str(repo), str(repo / "tests")]
from serve import AppHandler
import helpers
from selenium import webdriver
os.environ.update(SE_CACHE_PATH=str(repo / ".local" / "selenium"), SE_OFFLINE="true", SE_AVOID_STATS="true")


def serve(mode, requests, logged):
    class Handler(AppHandler):
        def do_GET(self):
            path = urlsplit(self.path).path
            requests.append(path)
            drop = {"connection-dropped": "/test-worker.js", "config-connection-dropped": "/runtime-config.json"}
            if path == drop.get(mode) or (mode == "dropped-once" and path == "/test-worker.js"
                                          and requests.count(path) == 1):
                self.close_connection = True
                self.connection.shutdown(2)
                return
            if path == "/test-worker.js" and mode == "http-404":
                return self.send_error(404)
            return super().do_GET()
        def log_message(self, format, *args):
            logged.append(format % args)
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), partial(Handler, test_mode=True))
    threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    return server


def browser(mode="normal"):
    options = webdriver.ChromeOptions()
    options.add_argument("--headless=new")
    options.set_capability("goog:loggingPrefs", {"browser": "ALL", "performance": "ALL"})
    driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=options)
    return driver


import hashlib, subprocess
git = lambda *args: subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], text=True).strip()
code = {"base_commit": git("rev-parse", "HEAD"),
        "tests_uncommitted_changes": git("status", "--porcelain", "--", "tests") or None,
        "helpers_sha256": hashlib.sha256((repo / "tests" / "helpers.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
report = {"code_under_probe": code, "evidence_type": "Local probe of a failed worker script request; deliberate server behaviour, not a runner fault",
          "created_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
          "python": platform.python_version(), "os": platform.platform(), "cases": [], "guard": []}
for mode in ["normal", "connection-dropped", "http-404", "config-connection-dropped"]:
    requests = []; logged = []; server = serve(mode, requests, logged); driver = browser(mode)
    try:
        report["browser_version"] = driver.capabilities.get("browserVersion")
        driver.get(f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/")
        time.sleep(4)
        report["cases"].append({
            "worker_script_response": mode,
            "page_state": driver.find_element("tag name", "html").get_attribute("data-state"),
            "console": [entry["message"].split(" ", 1)[1] for entry in driver.get_log("browser")],
            "network_failures": helpers.network_failures(driver),
            "server_received_worker_request": "/test-worker.js" in requests,
            "server_logged_worker_response": any("/test-worker.js" in line for line in logged),
        })
    finally:
        driver.quit(); server.shutdown(); server.server_close()
import warnings
for mode in ["dropped-once", "connection-dropped", "http-404"]:
    requests = []; logged = []; server = serve(mode, requests, logged); driver = browser(mode)
    port = str(server.server_port)
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        try:
            helpers.open_ready_page(driver, f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/", timeout=5)
            outcome = "ready"
        except BaseException as error:
            outcome = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}".replace(port, "<port>")
    try:
        kept = helpers.kept_logs(driver)
        evidence = {"console_entries": len(kept["console"]), "network_failures": kept["network"]}
    finally:
        driver.quit(); server.shutdown(); server.server_close()
    report["guard"].append({"worker_script_response": mode, "worker_requests_received": requests.count("/test-worker.js"),
                            "warnings": [str(w.message).replace(port, "<port>") for w in caught],
                            "open_ready_page": outcome, "kept_for_failure_evidence": evidence})
report["probe_source"] = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
report["limits"] = "One Windows machine and Chrome version. A dropped loopback connection gives net::ERR_ABORTED. The server writes a log line only when it sends a response, as in the CI job log. The failure a hosted runner gives was not observed."
assert not out.exists()
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
print(json.dumps({k: report[k] for k in ("cases", "guard")}, indent=1))
